statements.impact_statement: go.wasmcloud.dev/component v0.1.6 declares go 1.27.1, whose standard library has this vulnerability (fixed in Go 1.27.2). govulncheck, run with Go 1.27.1 for GOOS=wasip1 GOARCH=wasm, finds no call path from the SDK to the affected symbols. A component that calls them itself is affected; build with Go 1.27.2 or later.
